subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Food had to be simple and safe, and everyone had to explain where it came from.”?
options: It is also about what happens along the way.
It became a way to taste different homes.
The way to school became part of the lesson.
It simply gave others a way to notice them.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It is also about what happens along the way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Food had to be simple and safe, and everyone had to explain where it came from. It became a way to taste…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The way to school became part of the lesson.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It simply gave others a way to notice them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Food had to be simple and safe, and everyone had to explain where it came from. It became a way to taste different homes.」，答案為「It became a way to taste different homes.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It became a way to taste different homes.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
